en.headline: 359 own commits across nine repos, four skill-management and model-picker
en.teaser: Most of the window went into OpenCode tooling: a sandbox for agent evals, a skill switchboard that reached 1.2.0, and a model picker rewritten down to a fraction of its text.
en.overview:
The window was dominated by OpenCode-adjacent tooling. Work spread across nine of the user's own repositories plus issue activity in three upstream projects, with 359 own commits and 671 additional automated commits, 1 pull request, 15 issue actions and no reviews.

### Sandbox and evaluation notes

`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` was the busiest repository. Commits collected cross-model evaluations (DeepSeek V4.1 flash, MiniMax M3.1 Flash Free) of a single-file "pelican riding a bicycle" demo, moved evaluation output into an `evals/` directory with conventions written into `AGENTS.md`, and grew a knowledge base with new categories for reading notes, chrome-devtools-mcp behaviour, storage handling in OpenChamber and side-by-side eval comparisons. A pull request was opened there.

### Skill management releases

`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` shipped four releases in quick succession: v0.2.0, v1.0.0 as the first stable surface, v1.1.0 which switched all four actions from Markdown to a single validated JSON object, and v1.2.0 which fixed a false divergence warning caused by hidden internal agents and normalized frontmatter booleans. Alongside the releases the spec moved to v5 with relaxed enable criteria, single backups and atomic writes, and CI publishing was made idempotent.

### Model picker and translation

`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` released 2.0.0 with priced accounting and Console calibration, then 3.0.0 which cut the text the model must read by roughly an order of magnitude, and 3.0.1 which enforced a candidate menu and per-source chains. `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` was started from scratch: an MV3 extension skeleton, a provider protocol layer with presets and glossary pipeline, bilingual page rendering with chunk splitting and a circuit breaker, plus smoke tests and JSDoc type checking.

### Smaller projects and upstream reports

`sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` released 0.2.0 and 0.3.0, adding automatic CJK-aware text wrapping, overflow protection with font stepping, a bilingual CLI and a 40-image example gallery. `sogeisetsu/dsh-ecosystem-report` got mobile viewport fixes, a reworked theme switcher and a GitHub repository button; `sogeisetsu/dsh-openchamber-plugins` added a hidden-files toggle and two project skills. `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` fixed summary heading parsing, activity event pagination and CI window assertions, and added automatic AI failure diagnosis. Upstream, issues were opened against OpenChamber, PowerToys and opencode, and discussions were started in deepseek-harness and OpenChamber.

highlights.text: v1.0.0 marked the first stable release, freezing the four-action surface for 1.x.
v1.1.0 changed all four actions to return one JSON object validated by an output schema.
3.0.0 reduced the Markdown the model must read from 104,181 to 8,291 characters.
v0.3.0 added automatic line wrapping for CJK and Latin text plus overflow protection.
Opened a pull request in the agent sandbox repository.
Opened an issue about Hold-Win activation throwing NullReferenceException in Shortcut Guide.
Opened a bug report that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server OpenCode adds at runtime.
Started a discussion about the context-delta column being clipped in the stats tab.

zh.headline: 本人提交 359 次，覆盖九个仓库，技能管理与模型选择器共发布四个版本
zh.teaser: 这段时间主要投入 OpenCode 周边工具：智能体评测沙箱、升到 1.2.0 的技能开关，以及把说明文本大幅精简的模型选择器。
zh.overview:
本窗口的工作集中在 OpenCode 周边工具上，涉及本人名下的九个仓库，并在三个上游项目里有 issue 互动。总计本人提交 359 次，另有 671 次自动提交，1 个拉取请求，15 次 issue 互动（新开、关闭或评论），没有代码评审。

### 沙箱与评测记录

`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 是提交最多的仓库。提交内容围绕多个模型（DeepSeek V4.1 flash、MiniMax M3.1 Flash Free）对「鹈鹕骑自行车」单文件演示的横向评测，把评测产物收进 `evals/` 目录并把约定写进 `AGENTS.md`，同时扩充知识库，新增读书笔记、chrome-devtools-mcp 行为、OpenChamber 存储处理以及两版实现对比等类别。该仓库还开了一个拉取请求。

### 技能管理连续发版

`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 连续发布四个版本：v0.2.0；v1.0.0 作为首个稳定版本冻结 1.x 接口；v1.1.0 把四个动作从 Markdown 输出改为单个经 schema 校验的 JSON 对象；v1.2.0 修复了隐藏内部智能体导致的虚假差异告警，并统一了 frontmatter 布尔值解析。同期规范推进到 v5，放宽 enable 判据、改为单份备份加原子写，CI 发布也做成幂等。

### 模型选择器与翻译扩展

`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 先发布 2.0.0，加入计价核算与 Console 校准；3.0.0 把模型需要阅读的文本压缩了约一个数量级；3.0.1 强制候选菜单与按来源决定链长。`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 从零起步，搭出 MV3 扩展骨架、带预设与术语表的提供方协议层、支持分块与熔断的双语页面渲染，并补上冒烟测试与 JSDoc 类型检查。

### 其余项目与上游反馈

`sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` 发布 0.2.0 与 0.3.0，加入中英混排自动折行、溢出时逐级缩小字号、双语命令行和 40 张示例画廊。`sogeisetsu/dsh-ecosystem-report` 修复移动端视口与表格卡片，重做主题切换并加上 GitHub 仓库按钮；`sogeisetsu/dsh-openchamber-plugins` 新增隐藏文件开关和两个项目技能。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 修复小标题吞正文、活动事件分页与 CI 窗口断言，并加入 AI 失败自动诊断。上游方面，向 OpenChamber、PowerToys 和 opencode 提交了 issue，并在 deepseek-harness 与 OpenChamber 发起了讨论。

highlights.text: v1.0.0 是首个稳定版本，将四个动作的接口在 1.x 内冻结。
v1.1.0 把四个动作改为返回单个 JSON 对象，并由输出 schema 校验。
3.0.0 把模型需阅读的 Markdown 从 104,181 字符压到 8,291 字符。
v0.3.0 加入中日韩与拉丁文本的自动折行以及溢出保护。
在智能体沙箱仓库开了一个拉取请求。
提交 issue，反映快捷键指南中按住 Win 激活会抛 NullReferenceException。
提交缺陷报告：设置中的 MCP 页缺少 OpenCode 运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务。
发起讨论，指出统计页签的上下文增量被列宽裁掉。
